$comment: Brand settings for XOOTEQ. Edit, then run `npm run build`. Choices are proposals awaiting the user's approval; the reasons are in identity.json (signals) and campaigns/launch/brief.md. They echo the brand's own signals: a near-black ground (#0A0A0A), electric green (#00E676), a warm orange (#FF6B35), Syne + DM Sans + JetBrains Mono, cinematic dark photography.
name: XOOTEQ

color.$comment: Palettes by combination number (1-348) from Sanzo Wada's A Dictionary of Color Combinations; browse them in the brand hub (Colour tab). "primary" is the default (--<prefix>-bg, -ink, -accent ...). mode "light" puts the lightest colour in the background, "dark" the darkest. status: "placeholder" until the palettes are chosen, then "chosen". Proposal: combination 340 (Peach Red, Sea Green, Neutral Gray, Black) holds all three of the site's signals: Black, the most electric green of any combination that also has Black and an orange (Sea Green; 216 and 256 have duller greens), and the orange closest to #FF6B35 (Peach Red, Delta E about 6). Dark mode puts Wada Black on the ground like the site's #0A0A0A; roles are set so headlines are Wada White (as on the site), Sea Green is the one electric accent (7.1:1 on Black), White headlines 18.6:1, Neutral Gray carries body text (9.95:1) and Peach Red is kept for the warm second signal (5.5:1). 'daylight' is the same combination in light mode (Neutral Gray ground, Black ink) for print and the rare light piece.

typography.$comment: A pairing id from foundations/typography/source/pairings.json; compare them in the brand hub (Typography tab). scale is the ratio between type sizes (1.2 calm, 1.25 balanced, 1.333 bold). hand (optional) is one handwritten accent face from foundations/typography/source/handwritten.json, if the style allows it (approaches/<approach>/typography.json -> handwritten). Proposal: schibsted (Schibsted Grotesk + JetBrains Mono), rated core in Commercial Modernism. It is the closest pairing to the site's Syne + DM Sans + JetBrains Mono: a sturdy grotesque that carries a wide, tracked-capitals XOOTEQ wordmark at 800, a plain body like DM Sans, and the exact mono the site uses for its green labels. No hand face (the style allows none).
